[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### AI 与隐私"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"宠物通过任务状态、会话标识和计时信息判断当前状态，不需要读取会话正文、工具参数或附件。启用 AI 碎碎念后，所配置的人格、状态提示词和部位信息会发送给你选择的 AI 服务；费用与数据处理规则由该服务决"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"通过任务状态、会话标识和计时信息判断当前状态，不需要读取会话正文、工具参数或附件。启用 AI 碎碎念后，所配置的人格、状态提示词和部位信息会发送给你选择的 AI 服务；费用与数据处理规则由该服务决定。"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Features"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Feature | Description |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| Two display modes | In-app pet, or an automatically opened floating window on Desktop with always-"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"on-top and transparent-area click-through support |
| Task state tracking | Idle, working, waiting f"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"or confirmation, completed, failed and offline; idle stays in the idle state and does not automatica"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"lly sleep |
| Models | VRM 1.0 / 0.x and regular glTF/GLB; humanoid VRM bones are required for chara"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"cter motions |
| Motions | Included VRMA pack with per-state loop, one-shot, speed, expression, lip-"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"sync and gaze settings |
| Dance | Right-click to play a random dance; it ends when the motion finis"},{"id":"p28s7","text":"hes, on double-click, or when work starts |
| Interaction | Click or hold body parts for expressions"},{"id":"p28s8","text":" and chatter; drag, resize, rotate the view, follow the pointer and use spring-bone physics |
| Chat"},{"id":"p28s9","text":"ter | Built-in or custom lines, or AI-generated lines using a DSH model or an OpenAI-compatible serv"},{"id":"p28s10","text":"ice |
| Import | Import models as files and motion packs as folders. Imported files are copied into "},{"id":"p28s11","text":"plugin storage and no longer depend on their original paths |
| Language | The whole interface is Ch"},{"id":"p28s12","text":"inese and English, auto-detected from the system or DSH by default; a chooser (Auto / 中文 / English) "},{"id":"p28s13","text":"sits in General settings → Display, and on the first-run guide's welcome screen |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- Verified with DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2**.
